exactCanonicalSetting.sourceObservedSetting: feature.total_call_duration.twelve_day_mean: Mean daily total incoming plus outgoing call duration in minutes per day over the selected 12 days

inputBoundary: Exactly twelve caller-selected, uniquely identified recorded-day values for one participant. Each value is already the daily total incoming-plus-outgoing call duration in minutes; day identity is opaque and days need not be consecutive.
outputBoundary: One arithmetic mean of the twelve supplied daily total-call-duration values for each participant, in minutes per recorded day.
limitations: The source says twelve recorded days were selected to accommodate missing data but does not disclose which days were selected; selection and any completeness rule remain upstream.
Calendar-day construction, timezone, raw call direction classification, call-duration extraction, conversion to minutes, and daily summation remain upstream.
The source does not disclose whether a selected day with no retained calls is represented as zero or missing. This boundary never synthesizes zero and requires twelve explicit numeric daily values.
Missing, non-finite, negative, duplicate-day, or other-than-twelve-day inputs fail closed as typed-boundary violations; those rejection rules are Chronicle safeguards, not attributed source behavior.

The existing grouped-column primitive also computes sample standard deviation. This binding claims only its arithmetic-mean projection, not that extra output, the population descriptives, correlations, bootstrap intervals, or SPSS behavior.
No publication-time PHP/MySQL aggregation script or row-level study data was released; the values in this fixture are synthetic and method-shaped rather than a source-issued oracle.
